environment: Synthetic private workflow fixture only; no real news text or human review
validated_behaviors: The artifact bundle is bound to exact source manifest, cases and ledger hashes.
Every restricted adjudicated case must have exactly one versioned UTF-8 normalized text artifact.
Both independent reviews and the final adjudicated label have every Unicode span checked against the artifact.
Private text is not copied into the verified dataset version.
Path escape, symlink, corruption, stale hashes, partial attestation and a non-independent verifier fail closed.
The result remains non-publishable while sample, split, source and quality requirements are incomplete.
limitations: No production normalizer or real private artifact bundle was created in this unit.
The software cannot prove a verifier's real identity or that the person read the text.
Evidence integrity does not establish tone-label accuracy or model quality.
